basic_info.description: Experience luxury high-rise living in this stunning 11th-floor corner condo at The Post International. This spacious 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence offers wonderful light with sweeping south and west-facing views, including breathtaking outlooks of the City, St. Mary's Cathedral, and Sutro Tower.  Inside, you'll find hardwood floors throughout, abundant storage, and in-unit laundry. A desirable corner layout that separates the bedrooms and offers a spa-like primary suite including a soaking tub and separate shower. Deeded storage and parking with EV charger included.  Residents enjoy exceptional amenities, including a 24-hour doorperson/security, gym, elegant lobby, courtyard, conference room, and a package notification system. Located on Cathedral Hill offering easy access to Japantown, Hayes Valley, Pacific Heights, the Fillmore District, Alamo Square, and Lafayette Park. This home offers chic style, comfort, and convenience.
